standard.label: Standard copy
standard.tell: The card's ordinary copy, with nothing of its own.

print_run.label: Print run
print_run.tell: The same card from another print run, told apart by an edition stamp, a shadow or a copyright line.
print_run.description: The same card from another print run, told apart by an edition stamp, a shadow or a copyright line.

parallel.label: Parallel
parallel.tell: Another finish of the same print, such as a reverse holo or a pattern in the foil, with nothing else of its own.
parallel.description: Other finishes beside the standard copy, with nothing else of their own. With it, these make the master set.

serial_code.label: Serial-code variant
serial_code.tell: The same physical version with another serial code printed at the bottom. The code does not establish a chronological print run.

sources.title: Elite Fourum: complete list of ex era serial code numbers

serial_code.description: The same physical version with another serial code printed at the bottom. The code does not establish a chronological print run.

special.label: Special release
special.tell: A copy with a stamp, material or way of being handed out of its own.
special.description: Copies with a stamp, material or way of being handed out of their own: event and League stamps, deck- and box-only foils.

error.label: Error
error.tell: A copy printed with a mistake.

test.label: Test print
test.tell: Never sold: cut from test sheets that left the printer.
test.description: Never sold. Cut from test sheets that left the printer.

oversized.label: Oversized
oversized.tell: A jumbo copy, larger than a playing card.

stamp.label: Stamp
stamp.tell: A stamped logo or words the original doesn't have.

finish.label: Other finish
finish.tell: The foil differs from the original's.

rarity_mark.label: Other rarity mark
rarity_mark.tell: Another rarity symbol or letters by the collector number.

no_e_reader_strip.label: No e-Reader strip
no_e_reader_strip.tell: No e-Reader dot code along the card's edge.

no_number.label: No number
no_number.tell: No collector number or set symbol.

number.label: Own number
number.tell: Its own set symbol and collector number in place of the original's.

border.label: Other border
border.tell: Another border colour, such as the silver of a World Championships Deck card.

signature.label: Signature
signature.tell: A player's signature printed over the picture.

text.label: Reworded
text.tell: The same attacks and effects in newer wording.

non_holo.label: Non-holo
non_holo.tell: No foil anywhere on the card.

holo.label: Holo
holo.tell: The picture shines; the rest of the card doesn't.

poke_ball.label: Poké Ball pattern
poke_ball.tell: Reverse foil with Poké Balls worked into it, in rows or one large ball below the picture.

master_ball.label: Master Ball pattern
master_ball.tell: Reverse foil with Master Balls worked into it, the rarer twin of the Poké Ball pattern.

cosmos_holo.label: Cosmos holo
cosmos_holo.tell: Holo foil of dots and circles of different sizes, like a night sky.

energy_symbol.label: Energy symbol pattern
energy_symbol.tell: Reverse foil with the card's Energy symbol worked into it, behind the Pokémon or large below the picture.

sources.title: PokiPair: gem pack volume one everything you need to know

mirror_holo.label: Mirror holo
mirror_holo.tell: Foil with no pattern: a plain, mirror-like silver shine without the rainbow of holo foil.

pixel_cosmos_holo.label: Pixel cosmos holo
pixel_cosmos_holo.tell: Cosmos foil whose dots and circles are blocky, as if made of pixels, not smooth.

sources.title: Elite Fourum: pixel cosmos vs smooth cosmos holofoil

crosshatch_holo.label: Crosshatch holo
crosshatch_holo.tell: Foil of crossing diagonal lines, a shiny grid, usually everywhere but the picture.

glossy.label: Glossy
glossy.tell: No foil, but a glossy coat that looks a little shiny when held to the light.

sources.title: CGC Grading: ivy pikachu variant guide 2rcgd5Y1tdEpv53E1FkQgu
Elite Fourum: vending series and whf sheet

cracked_ice_holo.label: Cracked ice holo
cracked_ice_holo.tell: Foil broken into irregular shards, like cracked ice or shattered glass.

stars.label: Stars
stars.tell: Reverse foil scattered with small five-pointed stars.

sources.title: PokiPair: gem pack volume one everything you need to know

rotary.label: Rotary holo
rotary.tell: Reverse foil in a geometric pinwheel pattern across the whole card.

sources.title: PokiPair: gem pack volume one everything you need to know

vertical_line_holo.label: Vertical line holo
vertical_line_holo.tell: Holo foil of thin vertical lines across the picture.

sheen_holo.label: Sheen holo
sheen_holo.tell: Holo foil with no pattern whose shine sweeps diagonally across the picture.

reverse_cosmos_holo.label: Reverse cosmos holo
reverse_cosmos_holo.tell: Cosmos foil, dots and circles, everywhere but the picture.

confetti_holo.label: Confetti holo
confetti_holo.tell: Holo foil of small blocky flecks, like confetti.

confetti_reverse_holo.label: Confetti reverse holo

dusk_ball.label: Dusk Ball pattern

love_ball.label: Love Ball pattern

friend_ball.label: Friend Ball pattern

quick_ball.label: Quick Ball pattern

tinsel_holo.label: Tinsel holo
tinsel_holo.tell: Holo foil of fine horizontal stripes.

mirage_holo.label: Mirage holo
mirage_holo.tell: Holo foil with no pattern whose shine runs side to side, unlike sheen holo's diagonal.

water_web_holo.label: Water web holo
water_web_holo.tell: Holo foil of wavy lines, like rippling water.

sequin_holo.tell: Holo foil of many small geometric flecks, like sequins.

disco_holo.label: Disco holo
disco_holo.tell: Holo foil of small, tightly packed round dots, a pattern no released card uses: Base Set test prints only.

lenticular.label: Lenticular

metal.label: Metal

first_edition.label: 1st Edition
first_edition.tell: A 1st Edition symbol, usually on the other side of the card from the set symbol (beside it on early Japanese 1st Editions).

unlimited.label: Unlimited
unlimited.tell: No 1st Edition symbol: a later print run.

no_rarity.label: No rarity symbol

no_e_reader.tell: No e-Reader dot code along the card's edge.

product_promotion.label: In a product
product_promotion.tell: Came in a box, tin, collection or other product.

program.label: Program
program.tell: Given out through an organised-play program, such as Play! Pokémon or a League.

prize.label: Prize
prize.tell: Won at a tournament or event.

publication_promotion.label: Magazine or book
publication_promotion.tell: Came with a magazine, book or guide.

test.label: Test
test.tell: Never handed out: a test print.

promo.label: Promo
promo.tell: A Promo mark, which says nothing of how showy the card is: ranked with commons.

rare.label: Rare
rare.tell: A rare mark, with no holo or more of its own.

holo.label: Holo
holo.tell: Holo rares and their like: Holo Rare, the Japanese Rare (R), Prism Rare, Pikachu Rare.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.tell: Ultra rares: Ultra Rare, Double Rare, Triple Rare (RRR), Super Rare (SR), LEGEND, ACE SPEC, Radiant, Amazing, Shining and Shiny Rares, Character and Trainer Rares.

chase.label: Chase
chase.tell: Full-art illustrations and shiny full arts: Illustration and Art Rares, Mega Attack Rares, CSR, SSR, Shiny Ultra Rare, the Gem Pack Triple Rare, Classic Collection.

top_chase.label: Top chase
top_chase.tell: A set's top cards: Special Illustration and Special Art Rares, Hyper Rares and the Secret and Rainbow Rares before them, the Japanese Ultra Rare (UR), Gold Star, Black White, Futuristic and RGB Rares.

sources.title: pokemon.com: pokemon tcg scarlet and violet revamps pokemon tcg card aesthetic

v_union.label: V-UNION
v_union.tell: A V-UNION is printed in four quarters, each a card of its own, played together as one Pokémon.

legend.label: LEGEND
legend.tell: A LEGEND is printed in two halves, each a card of its own, played together as one Pokémon.
